description: Use when you are handed an AttestPage evidence receipt and need to check it before relying on it: verifies the compact JWS against this service's published keys and returns its payload, so a forged or altered receipt is caught. Free. Free. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/receipt-verify

receipt.description: The compact JWS from the "receipt" field of a response.

name: attestpage_verify_receipt

kid.description: Key id from the JWS header.

message.description: Plain-language failure reason, only when valid is false.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, only when valid is false.

valid.description: True when the signature verifies with one of our keys and the payload matches schema v1.

title: Verify an evidence receipt
